# neocloud_network_interface (Resource)

A network interface attached to a subnet. `attached_machine_id` attaches (value) or detaches (null) the interface to a virtual machine in place; every other network-level property forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "neocloud_network_interface" "example" {
  zone_id             = var.zone_id
  name                = "example-nic"
  attached_subnet_id  = neocloud_subnet.example.id
  attached_machine_id = neocloud_virtual_machine.example.id
  dr                   = false
}
```
